prompt:
THE BACKGROUND MUST BE FLAT SOLID MAGENTA #FF00FF, filling every pixel behind the figure, edge to edge. THE BACKGROUND IS NOT BLUE. IT IS NOT A SEA, NOT A SKY, NOT A HORIZON, NOT A SHORELINE, NOT A CLIFF, NOT WHITE, NOT GREY, NOT A GRADIENT, NOT FOG. If you are about to render sea or sky because the subject is a fisherman standing on rock, RENDER PURE MAGENTA #FF00FF INSTEAD. No shadow on the backdrop, no ground plane beyond the small stone he stands on, no frame, no border, no text, no watermark.

A FULL-LENGTH STANDING FIGURE, HEAD TO FEET, the whole body visible from the top of the head to the soles of both sandals, both feet resting on a small cut block of pale stone at the very bottom edge of the frame. NOT a bust, NOT a portrait, NOT cropped at the waist or the knees. A single character, standing, facing the viewer, drawn large.

SIMON PETER, THE FISHERMAN APOSTLE. A broad, solid, weathered middle-aged man with a warm, steady, kind face. Short grey-flecked dark hair, receding at the temples, and a full but neatly kept dark grey beard. Sun-browned skin, strong hands, a face that has worked outdoors for years. HE IS CALM AND WELCOMING, NOT stern, NOT angry, NOT sorrowful, NOT shouting, no halo, no glowing effects.

He wears a SAND-COLOURED belted TUNIC to mid-calf under a DEEP SEA-BLUE CLOAK draped over his left shoulder and falling down his back, a plain leather belt, and worn leather sandals. Simple, sturdy, homely fabric — a working man's clothes, not vestments and not armour.

IN HIS RAISED RIGHT HAND HE HOLDS UP TWO LARGE GOLD KEYS ON A SINGLE IRON RING, at about chest height, clearly visible against the tunic — old ornate keys with round bows and toothed wards, unmistakably TWO of them. His left hand is open and relaxed at his side in a gesture of greeting. NO weapon, no sword, no staff, no fish, no net in his hands.

HE STANDS ON A SINGLE CUT BLOCK OF PALE LIMESTONE BEDROCK — a squared foundation stone with visible chisel marks and one thin vein of gold running through it, no wider than his stance and no taller than his ankles. The stone sits directly at the bottom edge of the frame. NOTHING else on the ground, no grass, no water, no rubble.

Warm hand-illustrated storybook style with clean flat shapes and soft painted shading, matching the reference figures exactly in proportion, line weight and palette warmth. Head to feet, full length, both feet on the stone at the bottom edge, FLAT MAGENTA #FF00FF everywhere behind him.
